Sends a message to the user. Use for conversational responses, progress updates, asking clarifying questions, reporting results, or brainstorming. If you expect a response from the user, use the "get_user_input" action immediately after "say_to_user". This tool should NEVER be used twice in a row. 
Schema:
  message (str, required): The message text to display to the user.
Example: {"tool_name": "say_to_user", "parameters": {"message": "Analysis complete. Found 3 issues."}}
